answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a stake-weighted pulse check: every agent locks a small refundable deposit and must answer a periodic liveness pulse proving it controls unique compute. A crystal-clear reputation ledger mirrors each agent's history of completed work and disputes, so new identities start at zero trust and cannot inherit a good record. Cloning an identity then costs a fresh deposit plus the time to rebuild reputation, while one honest agent pays almost nothing: the attacker's cost scales with every fake, the defender's does not.
